inference: CPU only, -ngl 0, 8 threads, context 2048, one parallel sequence, F16 KV cache

prompt_hypotheses.minimal: Original two-source prompt without an explicit description of severity confounding.
prompt_hypotheses.causal_context: Adds the true mechanism that severity affects operator treatment choice and success; it does not identify the correct action or prescribe a source.

gate_rule: assess each framing independently; the screen diagnoses prompt-development feasibility and does not authorize confirmatory claims
primary_development_contrast: causal_context minus minimal prompt accuracy on paired items, with conflict accuracy emphasized
